calls.statement:
SELECT week_ending_date, count(*) AS n_rows, count(DISTINCT (store_key, product_key)) AS n_keys, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, min(etl_loaded_at) AS mn, max(etl_loaded_at) AS mx, sum(closing_units) AS units
FROM fact_stock_week WHERE week_ending_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-02' AND DATE '2026-10-04' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, min(s.store_name) AS nm, count(*) AS n, sum(fs.closing_units) AS units, min(fs.closing_units) AS min_units, sum(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_rows
FROM fact_stock_week fs JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=fs.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=fs.product_key
WHERE fs.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl, min(sale_date) AS mn, max(sale_date) AS mx, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads, sum(CASE WHEN quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos_qty, sum(quantity) AS qty
FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-24' AND DATE '2026-09-20'

WITH params AS (SELECT DATE '2026-09-27' AS week_ending),
closing AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(fs.closing_units) AS closing_units
    FROM fact_stock_week fs
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = fs.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = fs.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE fs.week_ending_date = params.week_ending AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
),
sold AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold_4w,
           SUM(CASE WHEN f.sale_date >= params.week_ending - 27 THEN 0 ELSE 0 END) AS dummy
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN params.week_ending - 34 AND params.week_ending - 7
      AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
),
sold_alt AS (
    SELECT cp.category, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_alt
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
    CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN params.week_ending - 27 AND params.week_ending
      AND s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT c.category, c.closing_units, s.units_sold_4w, ROUND(c.closing_units/(s.units_sold_4w/4.0),2) AS woc, ROUND(c.closing_units/(a.units_alt/4.0),2) AS woc_alt
FROM closing c LEFT JOIN sold s USING (category) LEFT JOIN sold_alt a USING (category) ORDER BY 1
